title: Combined beans board
summary: The combined work-plan board: a daily snapshot of the beans of every repository in `beans-sources.json` (`beans.json`, `README.md`) and the bean-drift report (`drift.json`, `drift.md`). Written by the Pull beans bot and kept on a state branch, never on main.
rationale: `state`, not `derived`: the bot writes it every day from other repositories' beans branches, which move without a commit here, so a copy on main is stale the moment it lands, and two copies of this repository (litlfred and WHO) committing it to their own main drifted apart daily (owner, 2026-11-19: "Bot writes to a state branch"). `recordsWork: false`: it is a reading of other repositories' work plans, and the work is counted on their beans.
description: the combined beans board and the bean-drift report, written by scripts/pull-beans.ts and scripts/programme/bean-drift.ts. A snapshot that the bot replaces each day, never edited by hand.
